name: web-neo-brutalist-designer-portfolio
title: Neo-brutalist designer portfolio with offset shadows and stickers
whatItIs: A long portfolio page on cream. Sections include project banners, testimonial cards in lilac with black borders and offset pastel layers, sparkle-star stickers, an About block with an arched sticker portrait and tool badges, a timeline, and a contact form with hard-shadowed fields.
whatItMeans: Energetic, confident and a bit cheeky: it feels like a personal brand with real personality, not a template.
techniques: Give every card a thick black outline and a hard offset shadow so it reads as a physical sticker.
Stack two coloured sheets behind a card at slight angles to make it look like a pile of notes.
Add small four-point sparkle shapes at card corners as playful punctuation.
Frame the portrait in a layered arch with tool logos as stickers around it.
Keep the base cream and black so lilac, mint, pink and yellow accents can be loud.
bestFor: Creative studios that want a playful voice

vocabulary.definition: A web style with thick borders, hard shadows, flat bright colour and raw layout.
A solid, unblurred shadow displaced to one side of an element.
A small icon or shape that appears stuck onto the layout.
A card with coloured sheets peeking out behind it.
